title: Read-only local Case owner snapshot integration for analyst loopback journey
goal: Load a bounded operator-supplied local JSON Case/Timeline/source snapshot and use existing authenticated Case picker, Timeline, navigation and preview handlers without changing the product objects or pretending production IAM/persistence
invariants: Immutable operator-controlled local snapshot; no browser-selected file, no data mutation, no production IAM or Shared Timeline Engine ownership claim
Reuse existing validated in-memory Case/Timeline/source access chain; never take permissions from HTTP flags
Only loopback ephemeral-token synthetic host; OPEN-013 remains unresolved
security_properties: Reject malformed, oversized, symlinked or non-regular snapshot file before binding listener
Trust only host-selected file and verify owner ACL membership with existing memory provider
No data exposure before bearer authentication; cross-tenant and denied source remain hidden

migration.rationale: Only read operator-supplied snapshot at startup; no migration or persistent mutation

rollback.strategy: revert this lot; built-in demo fixture remains default
